description: مرحباً! أنا مروى، طالبة مهتمة بالفضاء والعلوم والاستكشاف. أحب تعلم أشياء جديدة والعمل على أفكار مبتكرة، وخاصة المشاريع المرتبطة بالقمر والمريخ والعلوم. أبحث عن أعضاء متحمسين ومتعاونين يحبون الفضاء والابتكار، ويمكنهم المساعدة في البحث، البرمجة، التصميم أو تقديم الأفكار. هدفي أن نتعاون معاً ونصنع مشروعاً ممتعاً ومميزاً في NASA Space Apps! 🚀🌙🌍
summary:
AstroGeo-Analogs is an interactive global geospatial map featuring 30 high-fidelity terrestrial analog sites—15 simulating the Moon and 15 simulating Mars—derived from official NASA datasets (LRO and MRO). Built on an open-access platform, each location provides precise coordinates, real-world imagery, and scientific explanations comparing Earth terrains to lunar craters and Martian geology.

This project directly addresses the challenge of deep-space exploration by bridging planetary science with accessible Earth environments. Testing rovers and astronaut operations in space is extremely costly and risky; thus, identifying accurate terrestrial analogs is essential. AstroGeo-Analogs serves as a practical, cost-effective educational and scientific reference tool that empowers researchers, students, and space agencies worldwide to study, test, and train for humanity’s next giant leap to the Moon and Mars.
details: **How It Works & Functionality:** AstroGeo-Analogs is a global interactive geospatial platform that maps 30 scientifically verified terrestrial analog sites—15 mimicking lunar surfaces and 15 simulating Martian environments. Users can click on any pin worldwide to access exact geographic coordinates, high-resolution imagery, geological classifications, and direct comparisons between Earth's terrain and planetary data from NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO) and Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO). **Benefits & Intended Impact:** Testing space rovers, life-support systems, and astronaut protocols in actual space environments is prohibitively expensive and hazardous. AstroGeo-Analogs solves this by providing a centralized, free, and open-access field guide. Its intended impact is to democratize planetary science—helping researchers select optimal analog testbeds on Earth while giving students and space enthusiasts an immersive tool to explore space geology right from their screens. **Tools, Software & Data Used:** We utilized official NASA orbital datasets (LRO and MRO) for planetary terrain analysis, Google My Maps for geospatial plotting, layering, and interactive visualization, and Canva for designing our visual presentation and educational storytelling assets. **Creativity & Team Considerations:** Our team (Sons of the Universe) creatively bridged the gap between complex planetary remote sensing and accessible, user-friendly mapping. In developing this project, we carefully considered scientific accuracy, geographic diversity across all continents, ease of navigation without technical barriers, and global accessibility so anyone can explore humanity's next destinations on Earth before we reach the Moon and Mars.
